description: This file defines the class DynamicContentFieldsIndexAliasProvider, which implements index alias provisioning and content definition event handling for OrchardCore's GraphQL content management. It manages cache-based alias generation for content fields and responds to content lifecycle events to invalidate cache.

classes.name: DynamicContentFieldsIndexAliasProvider
classes.description: A class that provides index aliases for dynamic content fields and handles content definition events to manage cache invalidation.
